Cria um ficheiro `index.html` autónomo (HTML + CSS + JavaScript num único
ficheiro, sem dependências externas, sem CDN) que simule bolas a saltar dentro
de um polígono em rotação.

Requisitos da simulação:

- O polígono é um **nonágono regular** (9 lados), centrado no canvas, com raio
  de 260 px, a rodar em torno do seu centro a **360 graus em 7 segundos**, no
  sentido horário.
- Há **13 bolas**, todas com raio 14 px, numeradas de 0 a 12. O número tem de
  estar desenhado por cima de cada bola e tem de rodar com a bola, para se ver
  o spin.
- Física implementada por ti: gravidade, fricção do ar, fricção de contacto,
  restituição (coeficiente 0.82) e colisão bola-bola e bola-parede. As paredes
  estão em movimento, portanto a resposta à colisão tem de contar com a
  velocidade da parede no ponto de impacto.
- As bolas nunca podem sair do polígono nem sobrepor-se entre si.
- As bolas começam todas próximas do centro, com velocidade nula.
- **Não uses nenhuma biblioteca de física.** Escreve a deteção e a resposta à
  colisão tu próprio.

Contrato de verificação — obrigatório, o teste automático depende disto:

Expõe em `window.__bench` um objeto com um método `getState()` que devolve o
estado atual da simulação neste formato exato:

```js
window.__bench = {
  getState() {
    return {
      t: <segundos decorridos desde o início, número>,
      poly: {
        n: 9,
        radius: 260,
        cx: <centro x>,
        cy: <centro y>,
        angle: <ângulo atual do polígono em radianos>,
        periodSec: 7
      },
      balls: [ { id: 0, x: <num>, y: <num>, r: 14, vx: <num>, vy: <num> }, ... ]
    };
  }
};
```

Todas as coordenadas no mesmo referencial do canvas, em pixels.

Adicionalmente, expõe `window.__bench.step(dtSeconds)` que avança a simulação
de forma determinística em `dtSeconds` (usado pelo teste para não depender do
`requestAnimationFrame`). A animação normal continua a correr via
`requestAnimationFrame` quando `step` não é chamado.

Entrega apenas o ficheiro `index.html`. Não escrevas explicações fora do
ficheiro.

- Regular nonagon, radius 260, centered, rotating clockwise 360° in 7 seconds.
- 13 balls, radius 14, labeled 0–12, labels rotate with the ball (so each ball has an angle that updates based on its own spin — "tem de rodar com a bola, para se ver o spin (must rotate together with the ball, so that the spin is visible)". Actually "para se ver o spin (so that the spin is visible)" — the number rotates together with the ball so you can see the spin. So each ball should have a spin angle θ that changes when the ball bounces (like a rolling contact). Implementation idea: on wall collision, the wall's surface velocity at the contact point induces a change in angular velocity, and in addition there's air drag on the spin.

Physics:
- Gravity
- Air friction (linear drag)
- Contact friction (Coulomb friction between ball and wall, plus friction between balls)
- Coefficient of restitution 0.82
- Ball-ball and ball-wall collisions
- The walls are moving (rotating polygon), and the wall velocity at the contact point must be taken into account.
- Balls never leave the polygon, and never overlap.

Implementation approach:
- Substep-based fixed timestep. step(dt) advances deterministically: split dt into fixed substeps (e.g., dt/8 or based on a fixed 1/240 sec), and integrate each substep.
- Ball-wall collision: polygon edges as line segments (moving by rotation). For each ball, find the closest point on each edge (segment), compute penetration depth, normal, relative velocity including wall velocity at the contact point (ω × r), and apply impulse with restitution 0.82 and tangential friction. Also spin: the contact point on the ball has velocity v + ω × (-R*n... ) — more simply: a 2D spin scalar ω_ball (rad/s), contact point velocity = v_center + ω × r_vec, where r_vec goes from the center to the contact point (pointing in the normal direction, magnitude R). Tangential relative velocity includes the ω*14 term. This gives realistic spin effects and makes the spin visible.

- Ball-ball collision: standard impulse with restitution 0.82, plus position correction.

- Position correction: to guarantee "balls never leave the polygon or overlap", use iterative projection: after integration, repeatedly push balls out of walls based on the closest point on the edge. For balls: pairwise separation. A few iterations per substep.

- Determinism: step(dtSec) must be deterministic — use a fixed substep size regardless of dt? To be deterministic given dt, split into N = ceil(dt / h) substeps of dt/N each. h a constant, e.g., 1/240. Actually simpler: h = fixed, N = Math.max(1, Math.round(dt/h))? Floating point precision: for determinism just use N = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(dt / h)), with substep = dt/N. It's deterministic given dt (deterministic for the same dt). Tests will probably call step with a fixed dt. That's fine.

function solveWall(b, verts){

function solveWall(b, verts) {
  var acted = false;
  for (var e = 0; e < SIDES; e++) {
    var A = verts[e], B = verts[(e + 1) % SIDES];
    var abx = B[0] - A[0], aby = B[1] - A[1];
    var ab2 = abx * abx + aby * aby;
    var tt = ((b.x - A[0]) * abx + (b.y - A[1]) * aby) / ab2;
    if (tt < 0) tt = 0; else if (tt > 1) tt = 1;
    var qx = A[0] + abx * tt, qy = A[1] + aby * tt;
    var dx = b.x - qx, dy = b.y - qy;
    var d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    var r = b.r;
    if (d2 >= r * r) continue;
    var dist = Math.sqrt(d2);
    var nx, ny;
    if (dist > 1e-9) { nx = dx / dist; ny = dy / dist; }
    else {
      var el = Math.sqrt(ab2);
      nx = -aby / el; ny = abx / el;
      if ((CX - A[0]) * nx + (CY - A[1]) * ny < 0) { nx = -nx; ny = -ny; }
      dist = 0;
    }
    var pen = r - dist;
    b.x += nx * pen; b.y += ny * pen;
    acted = true;
    var rx = qx - CX, ry = qy - CY;
    var wvx = -OMEGA * ry, wvy = OMEGA * rx;
    var vn = (b.vx - wvx) * nx + (b.vy - wvy) * ny;
    if (vn < 0) {
      var Jn = -(1 + REST) * vn;
      b.vx += Jn * nx; b.vy += Jn * ny;
      var tx = -ny, ty = nx;
      var vt = (b.vx - wvx) * tx + (b.vy - wwy) * ty - b.w * r;   // typo note
      var Jt = -vt / 3;
      var cap = MU_WALL * Jn;   // Jn > 0
      if (Jt > cap) Jt = cap; else if (Jt < -cap) Jt = -cap;
      b.vx += Jt * tx; b.vy += Jt * ty;
      b.w += -2 * Jt / BR;      // -r Jt / I with I=0.5 r² → -2Jt/r (r=BR)
    }
  }
  return acted;
}

function solvePair(a, b) {
  var dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y;
  var min = a.r + b.r;
  var d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  if (d2 >= min * min) return false;
  var dist = Math.sqrt(d2);
  if (dist > 1e-9) { var nx = dx/dist, ny = dy/dist; } else { nx = 1; ny = 0; dist = 0; }
  var pen = min - dist;
  a.x -= nx * pen / 2; a.y -= ny * pen / 2;
  b.x += nx * pen / 2; b.y += ny * pen / 2;
  var vn = (b.vx - a.vx) * nx + (b.vy - a.vy) * ny;
  if (vn >= 0) return true;
  var Jn = -(1 + REST) * vn / 2;
  a.vx -= Jn * nx; a.vy -= Jn * ny;
  b.vx += Jn * nx; b.vy += Jn * ny;
  var tx = -ny, ty = nx;
  var vt = (b.vx - a.vx) * tx + (b.vy - a.vy) * ty - (dist * 0.5) * (a.w + b.w);
  var Jt = -vt / (2 + dist * dist / (BR * BR));
  var cap = MU_PAIR * Jn;
  if (Jt > cap) Jt = cap; else if (Jt < -cap) Jt = -cap;
  a.vx -= Jt * tx; a.vy -= Jt * ty;
  b.vx += Jt * tx; b.vy += Jt * ty;
  var dw = -Jt * dist / (BR * BR);
  a.w += dw; b.w += dw;
  return true;
}

function polyVerts(angle) {
  var v = [];
  var base = -Math.PI / 2;
  for (var k = 0; k < SIDES; k++) {
    var a = base + angle + k * (2 * Math.PI / SIDES);
    v.push([CX + POLY_R * Math.cos(a), CY + POLY_R * Math.sin(a)]);
  }
  return v;
}

function solveWall(b, verts) {
  var acted = false;
  for (var e = 0; e < SIDES; e++) {
    var A = verts[e], B = verts[(e + 1) % SIDES];
    var abx = B[0] - A[0], aby = B[1] - A[1];
    var ab2 = abx * abx + aby * aby;
    var tt = ((b.x - A[0]) * abx + (b.y - A[1]) * aby) / ab2;
    if (tt < 0) tt = 0;
    else if (tt > 1) tt = 1;
    var qx = A[0] + abx * tt, qy = A[1] + aby * tt;
    var dx = b.x - qx, dy = b.y - qy;
    var d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    if (d2 >= b.r * b.r) continue;
    var dist = Math.sqrt(d2);
    var nx, ny;
    if (dist > 1e-9) {
      nx = dx / dist; ny = dy / dist;
    } else {
      var el = Math.sqrt(ab2);
      nx = -aby / el; ny = abx / el;
      if ((CX - A[0]) * nx + (CY - A[1]) * ny < 0) { nx = -nx; ny = -ny; }
      dist = 0;
    }
    b.x += nx * (b.r - dist);
    b.y += ny * (b.r - dist);
    acted = true;

    // wall velocity at contact point (rigid body rotating at OMEGA about (CX,CY))
    var rx = qx - CX, ry = qy - CY;
    var wvx = -OMEGA * ry, wvy = OMEGA * rx;

    var vn = (b.vx - wvx) * nx + (b.vy - wvy) * ny;
    if (vn < 0) {
      var Jn = -(1 + REST) * vn;            // per unit mass
      b.vx += Jn * nx;
      b.vy += Jn * ny;

      var tx = -ny, ty = nx;
      var vt = (b.vx - wvx) * tx + (b.vy - wvy) * ty - b.w * b.r;
      var Jt = -vt / 3;                     // 1/m + r²/I = 1 + 2 = 3
      var cap = MU_WALL * Jn;
      if (Jt > cap) Jt = cap;
      else if (Jt < -cap) Jt = -cap;
      b.vx += Jt * tx;
      b.vy += Jt * ty;
      b.w += -2 * Jt / BR;                  // torque = -r Jt, I = ½ r²
    }
  }
  return acted;
}

function solvePair(a, b) {
  var dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y;
  var min = a.r + b.r;
  var d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  if (d2 >= min * min) return false;
  var dist = Math.sqrt(d2);
  var nx, ny;
  if (dist > 1e-9) { nx = dx / dist; ny = dy / dist; } else { nx = 1; ny = 0; dist = 0; }

  var pen = min - dist;
  a.x -= nx * pen * 0.5; a.y -= ny * pen * 0.5;
  b.x += nx * pen * 0.5; b.y += ny * pen * 0.5;

  var vn = (b.vx - a.vx) * nx + (b.vy - a.vy) * ny;
  if (vn >= 0) return true;

  var Jn = -(1 + REST) * vn * 0.5;
  a.vx -= Jn * nx; a.vy -= Jn * ny;
  b.vx += Jn * nx; b.vy += Jn * ny;

  var tx = -ny, ty = nx;
  var vt = (b.vx - a.vx) * tx + (b.vy - a.vy) * ty - 0.5 * dist * (a.w + b.w);
  var Jt = -vt / (2 + dist * dist / (BR * BR));
  var cap = MU_PAIR * Jn;
  if (Jt > cap) Jt = cap;
  else if (Jt < -cap) Jt = -cap;
  a.vx -= Jt * tx; a.vy -= Jt * ty;
  b.vx += Jt * tx; b.vy += Jt * ty;
  var dw = -Jt * dist / (BR * BR);
  a.w += dw;
  b.w += dw;
  return true;
}

function substep(h) {
  t += h;
  var verts = polyVerts(t * OMEGA);
  var b, k, sp, kd, it, i, j, acting;

  for (k = 0; k < NUM; k++) {
    b = balls[k];
    sp = Math.sqrt(b.vx * b.vx + b.vy * b.vy);
    kd = AIR_LIN + AIR_QUAD * sp;
    b.vx -= kd * b.vx * h;
    b.vy += (GRAV - kd * b.vy) * h;
    b.w *= Math.max(0, 1 - SPIN_DMP * h);
    b.x += b.vx * h;
    b.y += b.vy * h;
    b.theta += b.w * h;
  }

  for (it = 0; it < 6; it++) {
    acting = false;
    for (k = 0; k < NUM; k++) acting = solveWall(balls[k], verts) || acting;
    for (i = 0; i < NUM - 1; i++)
      for (j = i + 1; j < NUM; j++)
        acting = solvePair(balls[i], balls[j]) || acting;
    if (!acting) break;
  }
}

function advance(dtIn) {
  var dt = (typeof dtIn === 'number' && isFinite(dtIn) && dtIn > 0) ? dtIn : 0;
  if (dt > 0.5) dt = 0.5;
  if (dt <= 0) { render(); return; }
  var n = Math.ceil(dt / SUB_H - 1e-7);
  if (n < 1) n = 1;
  var h = dt / n;
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) substep(h);
  render();
}

function solveWall(b, verts){
  for (let k=0;k<SIDES;k++){
    const A = verts[k], B = verts[(k+1)%SIDES];
    // closest point
    const abx=B.x-A.x, aby=B.y-A.y;
    const ab2 = abx*abx+aby*aby;
    let tt = ((b.x-A.x)*abx + (b.y-A.y)*aby)/ab2;
    tt = tt<0?0:(tt>1?1:tt);
    const qx = A.x + abx*tt, qy = A.y + aby*tt;
    let dx = b.x - qx, dy = b.y - qy;
    let d2 = dx*dx + dy*dy;
    const r = b.r;
    if (d2 >= r*r) continue;
    let dist = Math.sqrt(d2);
    let nx, ny;

function solveWall(b, verts) {
  var acted = false;
  for (var e = 0; e < SIDES; e++) {
    var A = verts[e], B = verts[(e + 1) % SIDES];
    var abx = B[0] - A[0], aby = B[1] - A[1];
    var ab2 = abx * abx + aby * aby;
    var tt = ((b.x - A[0]) * abx + (b.y - A[1]) * aby) / ab2;
    if (tt < 0) tt = 0; else if (tt > 1) tt = 1;
    var qx = A[0] + abx * tt, qy = A[1] + aby * tt;
    var dx = b.x - qx, dy = b.y - qy;
    var d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    var r = b.r;
    if (d2 >= r * r) continue;
    var dist = Math.sqrt(d2);
    var nx, ny;
    if (dist > 1e-9) { nx = dx / dist; ny = dy / dist; }
    else {
      var el = Math.sqrt(ab2);
      nx = -aby / el; ny = abx / el;
      if ((CX - A[0]) * nx + (CY - A[1]) * ny < 0) { nx = -nx; ny = -ny; }
      dist = 0;
    }
    var pen = r - dist;
    b.x += nx * pen; b.y += ny * pen;
    acted = true;
    var rx = qx - CX, ry = qy - CY;
    var wvx = -OMEGA * ry, wvy = OMEGA * rx;
    var vn = (b.vx - wvx) * nx + (b.vy - wvy) * ny;
    if (vn < 0) {
      var Jn = -(1 + REST) * vn;
      b.vx += Jn * nx; b.vy += Jn * ny;
      var tx = -ny, ty = nx;
      var vt = (b.vx - wvx) * tx + (b.vy - wwy) * ty - b.w * r;   // typo note
      var Jt = -vt / 3;
      var cap = MU_WALL * Jn;   // Jn > 0
      if (Jt > cap) Jt = cap; else if (Jt < -cap) Jt = -cap;
      b.vx += Jt * tx; b.vy += Jt * ty;
      b.w += -2 * Jt / BR;      // -r Jt / I with I=0.5 r² → -2Jt/r (r=BR)
    }
  }
  return acted;
}

function solvePair(a, b) {
  var dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y;
  var min = a.r + b.r;
  var d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  if (d2 >= min * min) return false;
  var dist = Math.sqrt(d2);
  if (dist > 1e-9) { var nx = dx/dist, ny = dy/dist; } else { nx = 1; ny = 0; dist = 0; }
  var pen = min - dist;
  a.x -= nx * pen / 2; a.y -= ny * pen / 2;
  b.x += nx * pen / 2; b.y += ny * pen / 2;
  var vn = (b.vx - a.vx) * nx + (b.vy - a.vy) * ny;
  if (vn >= 0) return true;
  var Jn = -(1 + REST) * vn / 2;
  a.vx -= Jn * nx; a.vy -= Jn * ny;
  b.vx += Jn * nx; b.vy += Jn * ny;
  var tx = -ny, ty = nx;
  var vt = (b.vx - a.vx) * tx + (b.vy - a.vy) * ty - (dist * 0.5) * (a.w + b.w);
  var Jt = -vt / (2 + dist * dist / (BR * BR));
  var cap = MU_PAIR * Jn;
  if (Jt > cap) Jt = cap; else if (Jt < -cap) Jt = -cap;
  a.vx -= Jt * tx; a.vy -= Jt * ty;
  b.vx += Jt * tx; b.vy += Jt * ty;
  var dw = -Jt * dist / (BR * BR);
  a.w += dw; b.w += dw;
  return true;
}

```js
function polyVerts(angle) {
  var v = [];
  var base = -Math.PI / 2;
  for (var k = 0; k < SIDES; k++) {
    var a = base + angle + k * (2 * Math.PI / SIDES);
    v.push([CX + POLY_R * Math.cos(a), CY + POLY_R * Math.sin(a)]);
  }
  return v;
}

function solveWall(b, verts) {
  var acted = false;
  for (var e = 0; e < SIDES; e++) {
    var A = verts[e], B = verts[(e + 1) % SIDES];
    var abx = B[0] - A[0], aby = B[1] - A[1];
    var ab2 = abx * abx + aby * aby;
    var tt = ((b.x - A[0]) * abx + (b.y - A[1]) * aby) / ab2;
    if (tt < 0) tt = 0;
    else if (tt > 1) tt = 1;
    var qx = A[0] + abx * tt, qy = A[1] + aby * tt;
    var dx = b.x - qx, dy = b.y - qy;
    var d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    if (d2 >= b.r * b.r) continue;
    var dist = Math.sqrt(d2);
    var nx, ny;
    if (dist > 1e-9) {
      nx = dx / dist; ny = dy / dist;
    } else {
      var el = Math.sqrt(ab2);
      nx = -aby / el; ny = abx / el;
      if ((CX - A[0]) * nx + (CY - A[1]) * ny < 0) { nx = -nx; ny = -ny; }
      dist = 0;
    }
    b.x += nx * (b.r - dist);
    b.y += ny * (b.r - dist);
    acted = true;

    // wall velocity at contact point (rigid body rotating at OMEGA about (CX,CY))
    var rx = qx - CX, ry = qy - CY;
    var wvx = -OMEGA * ry, wvy = OMEGA * rx;

    var vn = (b.vx - wvx) * nx + (b.vy - wvy) * ny;
    if (vn < 0) {
      var Jn = -(1 + REST) * vn;            // per unit mass
      b.vx += Jn * nx;
      b.vy += Jn * ny;

      var tx = -ny, ty = nx;
      var vt = (b.vx - wvx) * tx + (b.vy - wvy) * ty - b.w * b.r;
      var Jt = -vt / 3;                     // 1/m + r²/I = 1 + 2 = 3
      var cap = MU_WALL * Jn;
      if (Jt > cap) Jt = cap;
      else if (Jt < -cap) Jt = -cap;
      b.vx += Jt * tx;
      b.vy += Jt * ty;
      b.w += -2 * Jt / BR;                  // torque = -r Jt, I = ½ r²
    }
  }
  return acted;
}

function solvePair(a, b) {
  var dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y;
  var min = a.r + b.r;
  var d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  if (d2 >= min * min) return false;
  var dist = Math.sqrt(d2);
  var nx, ny;
  if (dist > 1e-9) { nx = dx / dist; ny = dy / dist; } else { nx = 1; ny = 0; dist = 0; }

  var pen = min - dist;
  a.x -= nx * pen * 0.5; a.y -= ny * pen * 0.5;
  b.x += nx * pen * 0.5; b.y += ny * pen * 0.5;

  var vn = (b.vx - a.vx) * nx + (b.vy - a.vy) * ny;
  if (vn >= 0) return true;

  var Jn = -(1 + REST) * vn * 0.5;
  a.vx -= Jn * nx; a.vy -= Jn * ny;
  b.vx += Jn * nx; b.vy += Jn * ny;

  var tx = -ny, ty = nx;
  var vt = (b.vx - a.vx) * tx + (b.vy - a.vy) * ty - 0.5 * dist * (a.w + b.w);
  var Jt = -vt / (2 + dist * dist / (BR * BR));
  var cap = MU_PAIR * Jn;
  if (Jt > cap) Jt = cap;
  else if (Jt < -cap) Jt = -cap;
  a.vx -= Jt * tx; a.vy -= Jt * ty;
  b.vx += Jt * tx; b.vy += Jt * ty;
  var dw = -Jt * dist / (BR * BR);
  a.w += dw;
  b.w += dw;
  return true;
}

function substep(h) {
  t += h;
  var verts = polyVerts(t * OMEGA);
  var b, k, sp, kd, it, i, j, acting;

  for (k = 0; k < NUM; k++) {
    b = balls[k];
    sp = Math.sqrt(b.vx * b.vx + b.vy * b.vy);
    kd = AIR_LIN + AIR_QUAD * sp;
    b.vx -= kd * b.vx * h;
    b.vy += (GRAV - kd * b.vy) * h;
    b.w *= Math.max(0, 1 - SPIN_DMP * h);
    b.x += b.vx * h;
    b.y += b.vy * h;
    b.theta += b.w * h;
  }

  for (it = 0; it < 6; it++) {
    acting = false;
    for (k = 0; k < NUM; k++) acting = solveWall(balls[k], verts) || acting;
    for (i = 0; i < NUM - 1; i++)
      for (j = i + 1; j < NUM; j++)
        acting = solvePair(balls[i], balls[j]) || acting;
    if (!acting) break;
  }
}

function advance(dtIn) {
  var dt = (typeof dtIn === 'number' && isFinite(dtIn) && dtIn > 0) ? dtIn : 0;
  if (dt > 0.5) dt = 0.5;
  if (dt <= 0) { render(); return; }
  var n = Math.ceil(dt / SUB_H - 1e-7);
  if (n < 1) n = 1;
  var h = dt / n;
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) substep(h);
  render();
}

```js
function polyVerts(angle) {
  var v = [];
  var base = -Math.PI / 2;
  for (var k = 0; k < SIDES; k++) {
    var a = base + angle + k * (2 * Math.PI / SIDES);
    v.push([CX + POLY_R * Math.cos(a), CY + POLY_R * Math.sin(a)]);
  }
  return v;
}

function solveWall(b, verts) {
  var acted = false;
  for (var e = 0; e < SIDES; e++) {
    var A = verts[e], B = verts[(e + 1) % SIDES];
    var abx = B[0] - A[0], aby = B[1] - A[1];
    var ab2 = abx * abx + aby * aby;
    var tt = ((b.x - A[0]) * abx + (b.y - A[1]) * aby) / ab2;
    if (tt < 0) tt = 0;
    else if (tt > 1) tt = 1;
    var qx = A[0] + abx * tt, qy = A[1] + aby * tt;
    var dx = b.x - qx, dy = b.y - qy;
    var d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    if (d2 >= b.r * b.r) continue;
    var dist = Math.sqrt(d2);
    var nx, ny;
    if (dist > 1e-9) {
      nx = dx / dist; ny = dy / dist;
    } else {
      var el = Math.sqrt(ab2);
      nx = -aby / el; ny = abx / el;
      if ((CX - A[0]) * nx + (CY - A[1]) * ny < 0) { nx = -nx; ny = -ny; }
      dist = 0;
    }
    b.x += nx * (b.r - dist);
    b.y += ny * (b.r - dist);
    acted = true;

    // wall velocity at contact point (rigid body rotating at OMEGA about (CX,CY))
    var rx = qx - CX, ry = qy - CY;
    var wvx = -OMEGA * ry, wvy = OMEGA * rx;

    var vn = (b.vx - wvx) * nx + (b.vy - wvy) * ny;
    if (vn < 0) {
      var Jn = -(1 + REST) * vn;            // per unit mass
      b.vx += Jn * nx;
      b.vy += Jn * ny;

      var tx = -ny, ty = nx;
      var vt = (b.vx - wvx) * tx + (b.vy - wvy) * ty - b.w * b.r;
      var Jt = -vt / 3;                     // 1/m + r²/I = 1 + 2 = 3
      var cap = MU_WALL * Jn;
      if (Jt > cap) Jt = cap;
      else if (Jt < -cap) Jt = -cap;
      b.vx += Jt * tx;
      b.vy += Jt * ty;
      b.w += -2 * Jt / BR;                  // torque = -r Jt, I = ½ r²
    }
  }
  return acted;
}

function solvePair(a, b) {
  var dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y;
  var min = a.r + b.r;
  var d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  if (d2 >= min * min) return false;
  var dist = Math.sqrt(d2);
  var nx, ny;
  if (dist > 1e-9) { nx = dx / dist; ny = dy / dist; } else { nx = 1; ny = 0; dist = 0; }

  var pen = min - dist;
  a.x -= nx * pen * 0.5; a.y -= ny * pen * 0.5;
  b.x += nx * pen * 0.5; b.y += ny * pen * 0.5;

  var vn = (b.vx - a.vx) * nx + (b.vy - a.vy) * ny;
  if (vn >= 0) return true;

  var Jn = -(1 + REST) * vn * 0.5;
  a.vx -= Jn * nx; a.vy -= Jn * ny;
  b.vx += Jn * nx; b.vy += Jn * ny;

  var tx = -ny, ty = nx;
  var vt = (b.vx - a.vx) * tx + (b.vy - a.vy) * ty - 0.5 * dist * (a.w + b.w);
  var Jt = -vt / (2 + dist * dist / (BR * BR));
  var cap = MU_PAIR * Jn;
  if (Jt > cap) Jt = cap;
  else if (Jt < -cap) Jt = -cap;
  a.vx -= Jt * tx; a.vy -= Jt * ty;
  b.vx += Jt * tx; b.vy += Jt * ty;
  var dw = -Jt * dist / (BR * BR);
  a.w += dw;
  b.w += dw;
  return true;
}

function substep(h) {
  t += h;
  var verts = polyVerts(t * OMEGA);
  var b, k, sp, kd, it, i, j, acting;

  for (k = 0; k < NUM; k++) {
    b = balls[k];
    sp = Math.sqrt(b.vx * b.vx + b.vy * b.vy);
    kd = AIR_LIN + AIR_QUAD * sp;
    b.vx -= kd * b.vx * h;
    b.vy += (GRAV - kd * b.vy) * h;
    b.w *= Math.max(0, 1 - SPIN_DMP * h);
    b.x += b.vx * h;
    b.y += b.vy * h;
    b.theta += b.w * h;
  }

  for (it = 0; it < 6; it++) {
    acting = false;
    for (k = 0; k < NUM; k++) acting = solveWall(balls[k], verts) || acting;
    for (i = 0; i < NUM - 1; i++)
      for (j = i + 1; j < NUM; j++)
        acting = solvePair(balls[i], balls[j]) || acting;
    if (!acting) break;
  }
}

function advance(dtIn) {
  var dt = (typeof dtIn === 'number' && isFinite(dtIn) && dtIn > 0) ? dtIn : 0;
  if (dt > 0.5) dt = 0.5;
  if (dt <= 0) { render(); return; }
  var n = Math.ceil(dt / SUB_H - 1e-7);
  if (n < 1) n = 1;
  var h = dt / n;
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) substep(h);
  render();
}
